HPPSC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 228 Posts

HPPSC Recruitment 2026 short notice released for Medical Officer. Apply online before October 16 at the official HPPSC careers portal.

Updated September 18, 2026 06:22 PM

by J Nandhini Officially Verified

Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) has invited online applications for 228 Medical Officer (General Wing), Group A Job Trainee posts in the Health and Family Welfare Department, Himachal Pradesh. Eligible candidates can submit the Online Recruitment Application through the HPPSC website up to 16 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. Selected Job Trainees will receive Rs. 34,000 per month.

HPPSC Medical Officer Salary

Candidates appointed as Medical Officer (General Wing) Group A Job Trainees will receive fixed emoluments of Rs. 34,000 per month.

How to Apply for HPPSC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official HPPSC website at www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc.
  2. Open Advertisement No. 62/9-2026 for Medical Officer (General Wing).
  3. Read the detailed qualification, age, fee and eligibility conditions.
  4. Open the Online Recruitment Application portal.
  5. Complete the registration and enter the required personal and educational information.
  6. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting documents.
  7. Pay the applicable examination fee.
  8. Review the entered details and submit the application by 16 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.
  9. Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted through the HPPSC Online Recruitment Application portal.
  • Applications submitted through any other mode will be rejected.
  • Candidates must check the detailed advertisement before applying.
  • Applicants should verify their qualification, age, category and fee eligibility.
  • The online application link will close at 11:59 PM on 16 October 2026.
  • Candidates should retain a copy of the submitted application and fee receipt.
